description: This file declares the interface for a factory class that creates instances of IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper, used for handling protection metadata in GStreamer pipelines within the Rialto server component. It includes necessary headers, defines the factory class with creation methods, and is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace.

classes.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory
classes.description: An abstract factory class for creating IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper instances, facilitating the creation of protection metadata wrappers in GStreamer pipelines.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory instance.

methods.name: createProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper, given a shared pointer to an IGstWrapper.
